_comment: Example Taiga problems-metadata for this image. One entry per inverse task.
startup_command: the default publishes query/submit_answer/describe_oracle and
the model probes via query. Add --named-tools --problem-id <id> to publish one
named tool per declared oracle action instead.
Set the problem's grading strategy to `mcp` in Taiga, not the default
Rubric (Itemwise) — these tasks are graded deterministically by
grade_problem inside the container against golden/expected.json.
required_tools is empty on purpose: the model needs the oracle tools only,
and withholding bash means it cannot read the container filesystem.

problem_set.name: inverse-tasks
problem_set.description: Inverse tasks: recover a hidden cause by querying a budgeted oracle.
